query:
SELECT 
  c.name as company,
  COUNT(DISTINCT div.id) as divisions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dept.id) as departments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cl.id) as clients
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN divisions div ON div.companyId = c.id
LEFT JOIN departments dept ON dept.divisionId = div.id
LEFT JOIN clients cl ON cl.departmentId = dept.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.name;
